# `vland`
- **version**: 0.3.6

- **Usage**: `vland [--usage] <SUBCOMMAND>`

## Flags

### `--usage`

print KDL spec for this CLI (https://kdl.dev)

## `vland completion`

- **Usage**: `vland completion <shell>`

Prints a shell completion script for vland. Add your shell's line to its rc file:

    # bash — ~/.bashrc
    command -v vland >/dev/null 2>&1 && eval "$(vland completion bash 2>/dev/null)"

    # zsh — ~/.zshrc
    command -v vland >/dev/null 2>&1 && eval "$(vland completion zsh 2>/dev/null)"

    # fish — ~/.config/fish/config.fish
    command -v vland >/dev/null 2>&1; and vland completion fish 2>/dev/null | source

### Arguments

#### `<shell>`

target shell

**Choices:**

- `bash`
- `zsh`
- `fish`

## `vland init`

- **Usage**: `vland init [FLAGS] [name]`

Scaffold a new variableland project from one of the official templates.

### Arguments

#### `[name]`

project name (also used as the target directory)

### Flags

#### `-t --template <TEMPLATE>`

template to use

**Choices:**

- `library`
- `backend`
- `monorepo`

#### `--visibility <VISIBILITY>`

package visibility (library only)

**Choices:**

- `private`
- `public`

#### `-d --dir <DIR>`

target directory (default: ./<name>)

#### `--install`

install dependencies (skip prompt)

#### `--no-install`

skip dependency installation

#### `--git`

initialise git repository (skip prompt)

#### `--no-git`

skip git init

#### `-f --force`

overwrite existing directory
